information_flow: The first call emits one non-executable qualitative tradeoff disposition. The terminal constructor consumes that disposition and the common evidence, treats the disposition as authoritative only for cross-objective priorities, and emits one policy without inheriting the reversible repair-and-compression mechanism.
name: Ex Ante Behavioral Arbitration Edge
organization: two-call sequential lineage with separated arbitration and construction authority

calls.objective: Identify the inherited structural assumptions and settle one coherent qualitative disposition among the required behavioral dimensions using contract-level evidence. Treat anchor implementation details as non-authoritative context, propose no policy edits, and emit one arbitration record for immediate consumption.

Consume the arbitration record as fixed priority evidence, assess all common evidence directly, and materialize exactly one complete contract-compliant policy. Retain sole construction authority while excluding the inherited reversible repair-and-compression mechanism.
calls.role: single policy constructor under prior arbitration
